pipeline_name: Mouse Heart Masson Trichrome Fibrosis Pipeline v4

analysis_rules.preferred_denominator: manual myocardium mask if present, otherwise automatic tissue mask
analysis_rules.vessel_mask_definition: manual vessel mask should cover vessel lumen plus vessel wall/structure, but not deliberately trace the surrounding collagen ring
analysis_rules.perivascular_zone_definition: manual vessel mask dilated outward by perivascular_buffer_um when pixel size is known, otherwise perivascular_buffer_px_if_no_scale
analysis_rules.interstitial_zone_definition: analysis myocardium/tissue mask minus perivascular zones

mask_drawing_notes.zoom_pan: The mask drawing tool supports mouse-wheel zoom, plus/minus zoom, right/middle mouse drag panning, and keyboard panning.
mask_drawing_notes.performance: Only the visible crop is rendered while drawing masks, which is faster for large TIFFs.

threshold_tuning_notes.interactive_preview_max_dim: Interactive threshold tuning uses a downsampled preview for speed. Written HSV settings are applied to the full-resolution images during final quantification.
threshold_tuning_notes.recommended_start: Use --preview-max-dim 1200 or 1400 for responsiveness; increase only if fine collagen fibres are hard to judge.
